activity.notes: After returning to Babylonia in 312/311 BCE, Seleucus reconquered Babylon and in 311 styled himself strategos rather than resuming a simple satrapal title. He retained Babylonia as his power base while extending control through the Upper Satrapies, then assumed the royal title in 305 BCE. ATLAS records 311-305 BCE as a distinct restored-rule Activity and keeps his existing 305-281 BCE Seleucid kingship separate.

sources.title: Seleucus I Nicator — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: The Oxford Classical Dictionary states that Seleucus reconquered Babylon after returning in 312/311 BCE, declared himself strategos in 311, and took the royal title in 305 BCE.

sources.title: SELEUCUS — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica describes Seleucus's return to Babylonia in 312 BCE, recovery of his power base, and subsequent expansion before kingship.
